purpose: Maps the v42 property-charging demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system, including the post-merge statutory-source falsification for tenants.

mappings.product_miss: The coverage matrix already named mobility/vehicle/charging as a high-priority verified domain, but the BRF/property actor had only a housing-adaptation route. A generic answer could collapse a BRF's Ladda bilen application, company employee/tenant charging, the distinct company guest exception and an individual resident's 2026 charging-point request into one path, creating wrong timing, amount or approval implications. Red Team first falsified the company guest path, then post-merge falsified the resident law source because the public result covered both tenants and condominium holders while linking only Bostadsrättslagen.
product_surfaces: shared source registry and support-record schema
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use one property_charging capability in the existing shell/person product. Preserve only explicit coarse route facts, separate association and company use categories before applying state-aid/timing rules, ask work-start state only where it can change the route, preserve the company guest-start exception, and resolve an individual resident request to the current statute for the already-known coarse tenure. If tenure is unknown, present both authoritative tenant and condominium paths rather than guessing or adding a low-value question. No property charging app or duplicate matcher.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not place address, organisation number, parking-space identifier, exact project cost, quote text, vehicle details, aid-history documents, tenancy documents or raw story in URL, public eval feedback or learning events. Handoff is limited to coarse actor/focus/language plus optional coarse charging context, use category, resident parking scope and tenant/condominium tenure only when those facts were already explicit.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Naturvårdsverket and current Riksdagen SFS sources govern material claims. Tenant requests must resolve to Jordabalken 12 kap. 27 a § and condominium requests to Bostadsrättslagen 7 kap. 9 a §; an unknown tenure must not be collapsed to either statute. Normalized charging records remain NEEDS_REVIEW with human review required and zero AI-promoted material fields. Do not infer grant approval, aid intensity, de-minimis headroom, state-aid classification, work-start eligibility or resident statutory eligibility from natural-language input.
